name: company-deep-analysis
description: A reusable skill pack that turns a listed company (US / A-share / HK) into a fixed-format Chinese deep-analysis report with source-graded, verifiable data.

plugins.name: company-deep-analysis
plugins.description: Generate a 12-chapter 深度分析报告 for any listed company: fundamentals, valuation, famous-investor holdings with cost basis, insider trading, shareholder structure, recent events, executive interviews, future outlook and margin of safety. Enforces evidence grading, primary-source verification of every load-bearing number, and a blocking self-check before delivery.
